title: Get the Founding Member campaign ready to start on November 11

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-11-10: put the campaign plan on the Daniel Tyack Space calendar and the backlog; it should be ready by the 11th and start on the 11th.

detail: Preparation checklist for LIVE-BETA-LAUNCH-CAMPAIGN, to finish by November 11, 2026 so work starts that day. Drafts live in /mnt/project-files/campaign/ (FOUNDING-MEMBER-DRAFTS.md, AUDIENCE-FUNNELS-DRAFTS.md); 10 unsent Email Studio drafts and 2 draft Funnels (casual-browsers, web-followers) sit under danieltyack in Frequency Community. TO DO: (1) Daniel reviews the 10 drafts and 2 funnels and approves or edits copy. (2) Daniel approves audience lists: launch emails go to opted-in members (almost all free, only a couple paid); the pricing email leaves out current payers; casual browsers need on-site consent; people Daniel meets get a personal note first and marketing only after a yes. (3) Schedule launch emails: Nov 17, Dec 8, Dec 22 and Jan 1 at 10am Pacific; member re-engagement starts Nov 17 and skips anyone who got a launch email in the past 7 days. (4) Publish the two Funnels after review. (5) Settle the date conflict: SCAN-885 pinned December 1 against a December 31 beta end; RESOLVED 2026-11-10 (the pin and the opening copy moved to January 1 with #4721), so item (5) needs no probe change. (6) Confirm the stay-in-the-loop capture carries a consent line and no persona or wellness data reaches pixels or click parameters. The shipped come-back emails (lib/launch/comeback-email.ts) are unchanged. Nothing is sent until Daniel approves recipients, content and schedule.

verify.evidence: Fails today: no campaign email is scheduled and the two funnels are drafts. Passes when Daniel has approved the lists, the Nov 17 launch email and Nov 17 re-engagement are scheduled in Email Studio, and the funnels are published, with the date conflict settled.
